versions.changelog:
Initial release of app-packager skill:

- Automatically switches Git branches and executes app packaging scripts based on user requests.
- Supports parameters for branch, platform (android/ios/all), build type (debug/adhoc/release), version, upload options, API_KEY, and update descriptions.
- Provides CLI and natural language triggers for invocation; parses user intent and maps to script parameters.
- Performs pre-flight checks for project path, script permissions, and Git availability.
- Notifies user about packaging progress and returns detailed results, including generated files and download links.
- Designed specifically for app packaging scenarios—does not support merging, committing, unit testing, or code checking.
